static_traits.name: Lin Lei
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with some friends strained due to inferiority and comparison; has a supportive roommate, but has not yet opened up about feelings of shame
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problem history in the past; never received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, highly cooperative; able to self-Reflection and willing to practice reality testing and reframing; sensitive to others' evaluation, with 'should'-style self-Demands

basic_info.main_problem: I feel ashamed of my part-time Work, believing I should have Work that better matches my skill and pays more.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of shame are affecting my self-esteem and overall mental health.
growth_experiences: About a year ago after completing studies, Lin Lei was long unable to obtain a full-time position in the job search, and began to develop marked shame; whenever Seeing job postings or Hearing about friends' career progress, this shame and Self-denial are further activated.

Over the past year, frequently comparing with peers, contrasting own career progress with others, gradually forming the experience of 'falling behind, not as good as others', causing Relationship tension with some friends, and affecting daily self-care and motivation.

core_beliefs: I am a failure / not valuable enough
My worth depends on work achievements and income

special_situations.event: Seeing job postings related to own skill with higher salaries
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not obtained full-time Work matching my skill with higher pay, it proves I am wasting potential and am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases resume submissions, seeks career guidance online; at the same time avoids talking to others about true feelings to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am wasting potential, I have made no progress at all

special_situations.event: Hears news of a friend's career promotion or salary increase
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If peers are ahead while I have not achieved equally, it shows I am not as good as them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding interaction with these friends, Reduced socializing contact; spending more time scrolling job postings and comparing others' resumes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have fallen behind, I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: Considers seeking feedback from roommates or friends / sharing feelings of shame
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose my inadequacies, I will be looked down on or negatively evaluated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps silent, avoids self-exposure and seeking help, to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me, they will judge me

special_situations.event: Recalling the experience of long being unable to find full-time Work after completing studies
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not achieve the goal at a critical stage, it means I will always fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Drives more job-seeking action with self-criticism, but ignores the positive side of the current job to 'spur oneself'

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to have her abilities and worth affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, humiliated, or seen as a failure
defense_goal: Proving self-worth and easing the sense of worthlessness by pursuing more 'respectable' Work

object_relations.self_representation: A lagging and not-successful-enough person, a self easily negated

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on seeking feedback from others or honestly sharing feelings with roommates
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting own harsh self-criticism and negation onto others, experiencing it as 'others will look down on me / will judge me'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone, non-judgmental Clarification and validation, inviting concrete evidence and alternative Interpretations; normalizing the shame experience, slowly exploring the specific picture of their worry about being evaluated.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about career achievements and 'whether it is meaningful'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to discuss experiences with rational analysis, downplaying the expression of shame and vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slowing the pace, using reflection of feelings and present-experience-oriented questions ('where in your body do you feel it most right now?') to help bring the emotions in the narrative back to the present.

manifestations: Believing oneself to be 'wasting potential, having achieved nothing meaningful'
Treats career and income as the core measure of meaning and value
Not opening up feelings of shame to roommates or friends for fear of being judged
Relationships with some friends strained due to inferiority and comparison
outcomes: The support system has difficulty functioning

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently demanding of oneself with 'should have a more respectable / higher-paying job'
Treats society's / peers' career standards as the sole measure of her own worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Suppressing expression of shame and needs for fear of being judged
Overly cautious about sharing and seeking help, limiting contact with supporters

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interpreting own Self-denial experience as 'others will look down on me'
In social situations, presumes others hold negative views and thus avoids contact

positive_force: Has supportive roommates who can provide emotional and practical support
Has help-seeking motivation and is willing to practice reality testing and restructuring
Able to identify and acknowledge the positive side of the current Work (paying bills, gaining experience)
Continuously submits resumes and proactively seeks career guidance online
negative_force: Frequent social comparison, prone to triggering inferiority and shame
Highly binds self-worth to career achievement and income
Mental filtering and negating the positive leading to self-Reinforced sense of failure
Worry about others' judgment (mind-reading Anticipation) limiting help-seeking
Self-care declining, worsening Low mood and Insufficient motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation and shame Automatic thoughts (like 'I am wasting potential' 'I have no meaningful achievements')
antecedent: Recalling the experience of not yet obtaining full-time Work after completing studies
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates self-worth with career achievement and income, and engages in frequent social comparison
target_behavior.function: Maintains an illusion of 'spurring on' and control through self-criticism, while avoiding positive evidence to maintain cognitive consistency
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem,Decreased drive,Declining job satisfaction and performance

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids disclosing feelings to roommates/friends and seeking support
antecedent: Thinking of discussing shame and inadequacy with others
When advised to seek external feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged / shamed, Anticipation of projecting inner Self-denial onto others
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential negative evaluation to reduce Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, The support system has difficulty functioning, Loneliness and shame sustained

target_behavior.behavior: Declining self-care and daily routines (like insufficient motivation, reduced routine care)
antecedent: After comparison and feelings of failure are activated
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and Self-denial leading to reduced behavioral activation and avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping pressure and powerlessness in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Mood and energy decline further, forming a negative cycle
